name: cli_docs_bootstrap
description: Starting the REPL creates the project docs (agent.md, changelog.md) and the CLI's own docs (skills.md, commands.md, context/README.md in the CLI home). Old bug: the `ensure_cli_docs()` call was silently dropped from the startup bootstrap, so the CLI's own skill and command references were never created or refreshed; no test noticed because each piece worked when called directly.
